Application Data.NAME: Sunny Threads Boutique
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Fashion Ave, Suite 200, New York, NY 10001-2345
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Threads Boutique operates as a retail and wholesale clothing store specializing in a curated selection of fashionable apparel and accessories. The business focuses on providing a diverse inventory of high-quality clothing items for men, women, and children. In addition to the primary retail activities, we offer limited custom alterations and repairs, accounting for less than 10% of total operations to maintain compliance with underwriting guidelines. The majority of our sales are conducted in-store, with online sales constituting less than 25% of total revenue, ensuring a balanced sales mix that minimizes cyber risk. Our inventory is valued below $500,000, and we have implemented comprehensive security measures, including an advanced alarm system and video surveillance, to protect against theft and inventory loss.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 15, 2023, a theft incident occurred at our retail location resulting in a loss of $2,500. The theft was reported to the police, and a claim was filed with our insurance provider. The status of the claim is currently pending. Additionally, on August 30, 2023, we experienced water damage due to a plumbing issue, resulting in a loss of $2,500, which has been resolved. The claim for this incident has been closed.
